verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a client-side integration in which the server calls /sessions and payment data flows to your own client-side application. This is supported on web, iOS, Android, React Native and Flutter, with origin-scoped client keys, checkout styling customization and localization, which together amount to an embedded rather than redirected checkout. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the embeddable UI components (e.g., named component/drop-in modules) and their depth of customization, an explicit contrast with hosted-page redirects, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
